Usage: cortex [options] [message]

Commands:
  cortex exec
  cortex acp
  cortex resume [session_id]
  cortex connections

Options:
  -m, --model <model>              Model override
      --goal <prompt>              Submit the first headless message
  -r, --resume <session_id>        Resume a session by exact ID
      --session-id <session_id>    Set the session ID for a new session
      --output-format stream-json  Emit newline-delimited JSON
      --input-format stream-json   Read newline-delimited JSON from stdin

(Cortex Code v0.26.0916), SHA-256
30c477268c1a3da3295acca80e7cc3c12e8c65c787b15f565e717b14d0c9b666.

The release lacks the required stdio permission mediation option and an
append-only system-instruction flag. This sanitized fixture intentionally
records that failed admission result; it contains no account or credential
data.
